limitations: iOS Simulator is Mac-backed Safari, not physical iPhone performance
Rows are independent windows: median and p95 must not be pooled or averaged across poses
Historical comparisons span content and harness changes; matched reruns are required to attribute a new regression

The pregraph and midpoint controls are diagnostic comparisons, not substitutes for primary plain timings.

Previous milestone had no quiet window and higher/variable machine load. Safari travel misses were already present, but current worst frames and Signal/Driftwood single-run misses cannot be called unchanged.

verdict.knownConsoleFault: Frozen f542 grid had 12 malformed KTX2 resource URLs; fixed subsequently by c5ef7b1c1. Zero page errors does not mean zero console errors.

confirmedAdmissionRegression.reason: Standalone pond dressing was applied to a regional scene with no pond. Grid Pine was unreachable during this interval, so intervening milestones could not measure its drive.

likelyMechanism.confidence: Independent corroboration, not direct attribution of the uncaptured 852/983 ms frames
likelyMechanism.path: Pine plugin -> runtime/index.ts -> static shard.config.ts -> top-level parseShardfile validates all graph tables
likelyMechanism.interimPrewarm: sp-x4 in flight at receipt time; primary timings predate it

attribution.midpointObservation: Whole-case CPU profile contains short shardSchema and plugin install samples, but no captured ~1 s task or matching long parseShardfile task. It does not prove the original stall cause.
